verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs provides a hosted MCP server and CLI skill so an AI assistant (e.g., Claude) can create, configure, and manage agents via natural language, and agent testing can auto-generate test cases from real conversations that underperformed. However, these are external-assistant integrations rather than a native in-product generative AI that writes/improves prompts and workflow flows from a description. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in AI co-pilot inside the dashboard that drafts prompts/flows from a plain-language spec, and evidence of AI-generated (vs. conversation-derived) test cases.
